author: Temminck, 1815
habitat: 호수, 습지, 섬, 바닷가, 하천 어귀(번식지)
summary: 우리나라에서는 드물게 지나가는 나그네새이다. 온대 지역의 호수, 습지, 섬, 바닷가, 하천 어귀에서 번식하며, 물 위 수초에 갈대와 왕골 줄기, 수초를 쌓아 무리 지어 둥지를 만든다. 유럽 중남부와 동부, 아시아 중부, 아프리카, 아무르, 사할린 등 구북구 곳곳에서 번식하고 아프리카와 열대 아시아 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: white head with black marks on crown and upper neck (winter)
bill red in summer, black in winter

art.subject: White-winged Tern (Chlidonias leucopterus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean coastal wetlands in May: head, neck, breast and belly jet black; mantle and back blackish-grey; lesser and median wing coverts white, forming a white forewing that contrasts with the black body; flight feathers pale grey; rump and uppertail coverts white; tail very pale grey to white; underwing coverts black; undertail white; short dark red bill that can look blackish; dark eye; short bright red legs.
art.pose: flying low over shallow water, side view
art.scene: Korean coastal wetland near a river mouth in May, shallow water with aquatic plants; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view perched: jet-black head, neck, breast and belly, blackish-grey back, white forewing, white rump and tail, short dark red bill, red legs

adult non-breeding (late summer and autumn), side view perched: white forehead and face, black ear spot joined to a dark rear crown and upper neck, grey back, pale rump and white tail, white underparts, black bill
adult breeding in flight, seen from below, head, body and tail in line: black underwing coverts and black body contrasting with pale grey flight feathers and white tail
art.build: Small, compact marsh tern, about 25cm, slightly smaller and shorter-billed than Whiskered Tern; body about starling-sized with long, broad-based pointed wings. Bill short and fairly fine, clearly shorter than the head. Legs very short, red. At rest the wingtips project beyond the tail. Tail short and almost square, only slightly notched. Flight light and buoyant, dipping to the water surface.
avoid: Do not paint white cheeks under a black cap - that is Whiskered Tern; the breeding White-winged Tern's whole head is black.
Do not paint black or grey upperwing coverts; the forewing is white.
Do not paint a forked tail with streamers; the tail is short and nearly square.
Do not paint a dark smudge on the breast sides of the non-breeding bird - that marks Black Tern (Chlidonias niger).
